comment: Synthetic calibration corpus — mutations with ground truth BY CONSTRUCTION. generate-calibration-mutations.mjs renders each case's oracle+capture pair from the seed; the verdict-pin test (calibration-verdict.test.mjs) asserts the comparator reproduces every expectBand under the committed screenshot-thresholds.json, so a metric or threshold change that shifts any verdict fails figma:verify. expect (pass|minor|fail) is the calibrator's three-class ground truth. The expectBand values PIN CURRENT BEHAVIOUR of the calibrated defaults (doctrine 6.5); re-pin deliberately when thresholds are re-calibrated.

mutations.name: ShiftThreeV
mutations.note: beyond the +-2px search - the striped list anti-aligns (fine-content misalignment)

mutations.name: MoveList
mutations.note: ONE fine-content node locally displaced - the zone/cell floor must catch what the global mean averages away

mutations.name: MoveIcon
mutations.note: KNOWN METRIC LIMIT pinned deliberately: a small SOLID node displaced within its cell keeps high luma-v2 SSIM; bbox displacement is the spec-compare gate's territory (declarative element geometry)

mutations.name: DimIcon
mutations.note: KNOWN METRIC LIMIT pinned deliberately: luma-normalized SSIM forgives a uniform local dim of a solid fill; the Delta-E colour axis flags it advisorily (spec-compare owns token-level colour)

mutations.name: TintCard
mutations.note: colour drift SSIM forgives - the Delta-E axis flags it advisorily

mutations.name: ExtraPanel
mutations.note: render-added content on clean background OUTSIDE the oracle mask: the oracle-masked SCORE stays ~1.0 (so for score-sweeps this is class pass - inseparable by construction), and the RENDER_EXTRA_CONTENT witness is the pinned catcher

mutations.name: BlurOne
mutations.note: BAND-DECIDED pin: diffuse whole-frame softening lands in the MINOR band by the global mean with NO zone below its floor - a weakened `minor`/`pass` commit flips THIS verdict

mutations.name: BlurTwo
mutations.note: BAND-DECIDED pin: heavier diffuse softening lands in the MAJOR band (blocking since the 2026-07-02 promotion) by the global mean alone - a weakened `major`/`minor` commit flips THIS verdict
